name: booli-mcp
description: Booli.se real estate tools for Claude — search listings, sold prices, areas, and market stats

caller_id.title: Booli caller id
caller_id.description: Your Booli API caller id (request one at booli.se/p/api). Stored as BOOLI_CALLER_ID.

api_key.title: Booli API key
api_key.description: Your Booli API key/secret (emailed after accepting Booli's API terms). Stored as BOOLI_API_KEY.

tools.name: booli_search_areas
tools.description: Resolve a place name or coordinate to Booli area ids

tools.name: booli_search_listings
tools.description: Search active for-sale listings by area and filters

tools.name: booli_get_listing
tools.description: Full detail for one active for-sale listing by Booli id

tools.name: booli_search_sold
tools.description: Search sold listings (slutpriser) with final prices

tools.name: booli_get_sold
tools.description: Full detail for one sold listing by Booli id

tools.name: booli_market_stats
tools.description: Median/average sold-price statistics for an area

tools.name: booli_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the Booli API is reachable and credentials work
